page_title: GEN 2-0 UDI | Genoa v Udinese 24/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
89' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Josep Martinez, who smothers the ball.
87' Substitution. Milan Badelj did his best and is replaced by Kevin Strootman (Genoa).
86' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francesco Fourneau had an easy-decision to make.
86' Gabriele Cioffi has decided to make a change. Oier Zarraga (Udinese) replaces Sandi Lovric.
85' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
84' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Genoa comes to nothing.
82' The shots on goal statistics – 4:1.
80' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) serves up a nice cross, but Maduka Okoye punches the ball away.
79' Substitution. Mateo Retegui walks off the pitch and Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) comes on as a substitute.
78' It is time for a substitution. Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) is on for Junior Messias.
78' Alberto Gilardino decides to make a substitution. Stefano Sabelli will be replaced by Djed Spence (Genoa).
78' The substitution has been made. Keinan Davis (Udinese) has replaced Florian Thauvin.
76' Genoa control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
75' The referee blows his whistle, Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
73' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
70' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Francesco Fourneau saw the whole situation.
65' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
65' Genoa can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
65' The percentage of ball possession is – 62:38.
61' The resulting set piece from Genoa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

61' Milan Badelj (Genoa) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes towards the roof of the net, but Maduka Okoye keeps it out with an amazing save. Genoa will take a corner kick.
60' The referee points to the corner flag and Genoa will take a corner.
59' An attempted cross from Hassane Kamara (Udinese) is cleared.
57' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
57' The Genoa players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
54' Substitution. Johan Vasquez will be replaced by Alessandro Vogliacco (Genoa).
54' Gabriele Cioffi prepares a substitution. Jordan Zemura is replaced by Hassane Kamara (Udinese).
54' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lazar Samardzic trots off the pitch and is replaced by Joao Ferreira (Udinese).
52' Genoa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
49' Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) does not realise that he has already received a yellow card and is shocked when the referee shows him a second one!
49' Junior Messias (Genoa) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
47' Junior Messias (Genoa) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
46' Gabriele Cioffi has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Festy Ebosele (Udinese) comes on the pitch for Kingsley Ehizibue.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
42' Yellow card. Thomas Kristensen (Udinese) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
40' 2 - 0 Mattia Bani (Genoa) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header inside the left post. Excellent finish.
39' Nehuen Perez (Udinese) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for a foul.
36' 1 - 0 Goal! Mateo Retegui (Genoa) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper into the bottom right corner. 1:0.

32' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) rises high to connect with a cross from the corner kick, but his decent header crashes against the right post and ricochets away! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
32' The ball goes behind for a corner. Genoa will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
30' Koni De Winter (Genoa) has tested the patience of referee Francesco Fourneau and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
30' Genoa failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

29' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Genoa. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Genoa will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
29' Junior Messias (Genoa) takes a mid-range free kick and the effort crashes into the defensive wall. Genoa get a corner.
27' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Maduka Okoye.
25' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) leaps high to meet a lofted pass around the penalty spot, but his header crashes against the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
21' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
17' Great teamplay by Genoa as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
15' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
13' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) makes a rough challenge and Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Walace (Udinese) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Josep Martinez makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom right corner.
7' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
7' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
5' Udinese quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
4' Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. Udinese win a corner.
3' Maduka Okoye displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Junior Messias (Genoa) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
2' Francesco Fourneau shows a yellow card to Lautaro Giannetti (Udinese) for his blatant foul.

Udinese will kick the game off.
